items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I knew a lot of guys in Basie’s band. I knew Snooky and Frank Foster and Frank Wess and Charlie Fowlkes and Joe Newman and Freddie Green and Eddie Jones.

ctx.x: In fact that’s where I first saw him was with Count Basie and then I met him later when we worked with him on the show.
I knew a lot of guys in Basie’s band. I knew Snooky and Frank Foster and Frank Wess and Charlie Fowlkes and Joe Newman and Freddie Green and Eddie Jones. Like the 60s.
Yeah. It was that nice thing.
